title: Repair original artifact public readback settling after actual restore timeout

root_cause_analysis.investigation: Actual Root 38962069349 baseline-restore failure (lines 6356-6358 of controller job 117181863260): HTTP.open at line 173 with timeout=10 failed at 21:16:07 with TimeoutError/exit 124 while lease was verified through 21:19:41.
root_cause_analysis.compensation: Original compensation 14 checks (1bcf814a) and 4-whole ACK (22cc1bfb) verified baseline M/FE 1f9 and Publisher restored (2bfe0174).
root_cause_analysis.upstream_evidence: Original Caddy selected-window GET returned 0 rows and template has no access log; exact URL and upstream reason are not retained and not invented; genuine upstream cause remains unknown without hosted access log.

implementation_summary.scripts/dev_release_artifact_driver.py: Updated request helper in _public to allow at most 3 same GET attempts under fresh barrier checks when transient transport timeouts (TimeoutError / urllib.error.URLError with TimeoutError reason) occur, providing bounded settling before declaring restore failed. Preserved original 10s per-attempt socket limit, no retry of auth POST, no mutation replay, immediate fail-fast on status/source/auth mismatch, and no secret diagnostic exposure.
implementation_summary.scripts/test_dev_release_artifact_driver: Added 7 targeted test cases exercising: (1) transient TimeoutError recovers on attempt 2 and verifies complete readback without repeating container mutations; (2) transient URLError(TimeoutError) recovers on attempt 2; (3) persistent timeout fails at 3-attempt bound without extra calls; (4) bad identity, status 500, or auth posture fails immediately on attempt 1 without retry; (5) login POST timeout is never retried; (6) lease loss between attempts cancels via barrier.check() before attempt 2; (7) main() reports exit code 124 and structured failure record with failure_kind: timeout without leaking secrets.
